order: feedback then control; sequential on one worker; not randomized
selected_version_rule: Accepted candidate after complete paired validation, otherwise initial baseline for completed unchanged/regression decision. Incomplete or invalid generation stops study.
sealed_plan: Compare initial baseline against each distinct selected version. Share one report only when selections are identical. No sealed feedback enters selection.
stop_rule: No replacement candidates or automatic retry of failed/unknown calls. Keep partial reports and all previous attempts.
scope: Single candidate per arm and small task set; no statistical significance claim.
new_protocol_reason: Adds Responses terminal-event decoding and content-free failure receipts; preserves known usage on failed/incomplete responses. Prior failure cause remains unknown. Same model, initial asset, case definitions, prompts, image, budgets and gate. No previous partial trial is reused.
previous_study_disposition: Stopped incomplete with one unknown call; control and sealed stages not started. Record retained in 2026-11-10-feedback-01-result.json.
